profile.headline: MSSE | Senior Software Developer | NodeJS | React | Angular | AWS | Artificial Intelligence
profile.summary:
Senior Full-Stack developer with more than seven years of experience developing and maintaining web applications with strong knowledge of data structure and algorithms. Also, I have developed some Android applications and, I have acquired knowledge about Machine Learning and Data Scientist. Innovator, organized and methodic professional, with the ability to learn new technologies, exceed the limits to get the best result in the proposal goals, and improve every day to become a significant part of the work team with creative software solutions.
A team player with excellent skills in software development and acquire new knowledge, work well under pressure, passionate about the technology and take the problems as new challenges to achieve success.

Developed the BPMS Mobile app for Android and iOS. 
- Incorporated a module to visualize the metrics dashboard, dynamic tables, and report generator. Delighted customers by providing real-time global and local metrics of active processes in the company.
